overview: The Medford School Committee organized for its new term, electing its vice chair and secretary. The committee also adopted the 2024–2025 school calendar, revised the superintendent's evaluation goals, and launched a donation campaign for the McGlynn Elementary playground.

items.title: Reorganization: Election of Vice Chair and Secretary
items.summary: Elected Jenny Graham as vice chair and Paul Ruseau as secretary.

items.title: Good of the Order
items.summary: Members discussed subcommittee preferences, an upcoming training on Chapter 70 education funding by Tracy Novick, and setting future school committee goals.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved bills and payrolls and approved the December 18, 2023 minutes as amended to correct a spelling error.

items.title: Superintendent's Updates and Comments
items.summary: Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent shared updates regarding kindergarten registration, athletic achievements, and an upcoming tiered focus monitoring review of special education.

items.title: Leadership for Social Change Presentation
items.summary: Class of 2023 graduate Teagan Mustone presented her pre-college project advocating for increased accessibility, staffing, and funding for the performing arts and marching band.

items.title: Roberts Elementary School Update
items.summary: Principal Michelle Crowell presented on Roberts Elementary School initiatives, responsive classroom programs, and current staffing and enrollment needs.

items.title: Acceptance of Donations
items.summary: Accepted a $4,851.77 donation from the Consulate General of Italy for the Italian language program and an estimated $1,200 in classroom supplies from Elizabeth Cronin.

items.title: Revised Superintendent's Evaluation Goals (2023-2024)
items.summary: Approved the superintendent's revised evaluation goals as amended to remove key action 12 regarding strategic plan engagement due to capacity demands surrounding the MSBA process.

items.title: 2024-2025 School Year Calendar
items.summary: Approved Calendar A to observe religious holidays, and voted to send alternative options B and C to a committee of the whole for further discussion of calendar policy.

items.title: Resolution 2024-01: McGlynn Playground Replacement Initiative
items.summary: Approved a resolution establishing a donation campaign for the McGlynn Elementary playground, and voted to memorialize former student Emily Oliveira as part of the inclusive playground.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: Expressed condolences to the families of Judith Granara, Ernest A. Artelino Sr., Michael Jay Hamilton, Patricia M. Walsh-Devor, and Anthony Milley.
